messages.author: d85ad0502ab69008
messages.subject: multiple surveys in dsims
parts:
Hello! 
I'm wondering if there is a way to specify in dsims when you are running a simulation that you would like to include multiple iterations of the survey in the simulation rather than just a single one. We are planning to use the same survey design to visit our study area seasonally, and we are wondering how having multiple surveys with additional detections may affect our simulation outcomes before we decide on a final design. For now, I am going to run the simulation with a complementary zigzag design to simulate two surveys. 
Thanks for any advice you can provide. 
Janet

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] multiple surveys in dsims
parts:
Janet

I don't think there is an explicit way to incorporate a temporal component (as in temporal survey replicates) in dsims​.

If you are intending to combine the data from your seasonal replicate surveys to produce a single estimate, you could analyse such data by multiplying your transect lengths by the number of temporal replicates. You could do something like that in dsims​ by designing surveys with, say, twice the amount of effort, to mimic the temporal replicates.  Of course, this simulation approach cannot incorporate seasonal distribution shifts nor seasonal changes in detectability.
